messages.text:
BL-1497 — commit_integrity_lib's checkout lock outlives a holder that dies mid-commit and no caller ever reaps it: the specifier's commit was in flight at 07:53:29 BST on 2026-09-08 when the swarm respawned, `.git/swarmforge-commit-integrity.lock` stayed behind empty, and every shared-checkout writer failed lock-timeout attempts:0 until it was rmdir'd by hand; acquire-lock! records its owner and reaps a lock whose owner is dead or whose record-less directory is past an age bound, never a live one
What it solves: - Minted 2026-09-08 by the specifier. Article 3.2.4: type defect,
  severity high - expedited ordering.
- The BL-419 hardener pass (Specification.MD, BL-419 entry) explicitly
  chose to BOUND the wait and leave the orphan for a caller to clear;
  this ticket adds the clear, keeping that bound.
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM: a lock whose recorded owner is alive is never removed,…
BL-1497 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1497" (or "reject BL-1497 <reason>") to act.
